mpi_reference.note: On MPI-INF-3DHP one pair was the development pair. Here all 180 pairs are held out.

long_axis_variant.note: Symmetric legs, plus both arms rebuilt from shoulder-to-elbow and elbow-to-wrist instead of thorax-to-shoulder.

symmetric_leg_variant.note: Both legs use hip-to-knee as primary axis and knee-to-ankle as secondary. The shipped table uses root-to-hip for the left leg only. canonical/multiscale.py is unmodified.
